title: Red Hat Security Advisory: webkit2gtk3 security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in the ANGLE component used by the WebKitGTK port for the GTK platform. These include use-after-free, out-of-bounds read and write, buffer overflow, type confusion, and uninitialized resource issues. The vulnerabilities affect the chromium-browser's ANGLE library and have been addressed in a security update for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9. The update is rated as Important by Red Hat Product Security.
